body:
AUTHORITATIVE WORKER ASSIGNMENT — controlled monophonic motif robustness

EARWORM_ASSIGNMENT_ID=earworm-controlled-motif-robustness-v1
Instruction version: 1
Exact starting main: `429389909f1c6119b13fac3d8247b03f9524571c`.

Brian now authorizes continuing the four-stage roadmap with bounded local implementation-and-run assignments. This supersedes the one-experiment-only stop in comment 5745985350 for new, decision-qualified roadmap stages. Historical artifacts and results remain frozen. The existing reviewer prompt has been updated in place. Brian will align/wake the existing worker; no duplicate worker is dispatched here.

RECONCILIATION
PR #8 is reviewed and merged; completion receipt 5745957446 and PM receipt 5745985350 establish branch B. No open successor PR exists at this read. The worker reported stopping/releasing its lock. Local live-process state is not remotely verified: check the existing lock/checkpoint before starting and reuse matching work if present. Keep estimator-channel-provenance-v1 deferred (receipt 5745638206); it is not a prerequisite. Stage 2 and uniform-transposition comparison are complete. Do not rerun them or seek relational superiority.

Decision: can the selected simple acoustic retrieval predictor be carried forward to a controlled isolated-voice test without supplied note boundaries, or must an observation/readout prerequisite be repaired first?
Result A → if the frozen selected reference passes the robustness criteria below, retain it and make the next reviewed stage a bounded continuous isolated-voice boundary test.
Result B → if the frozen reference fails but a preregistered development/calibration-only reparameterization of the SAME retrieval mechanism passes and materially improves it, select that version for the next boundary stage, preserving the original reference and its historical result.
Result C → if neither passes and the bounded diagnostic localizes an observation or readout prerequisite failure, withhold the robustness claim and make the next reviewed stage one targeted repair with fresh confirmatory groups; do not advance acoustic complexity.
Inconclusive → preserve all outcomes; no forced mechanism choice or automatic audit. The PM must present Brian one concrete choice about the unresolved prerequisite or an independently justified alternative stage.
Stop condition: one frozen fresh evaluation, one complete reproducible successor snapshot and branch receipt, then awaiting-review and stop. These branches guide the PM AFTER review; they do not authorize the worker to start a second study.

IMPLEMENT AND RUN THIS TEST
Use `experiments/controlled-motif-robustness-v1/`. Start from the simpler `retrieval_transposed` selected in PR #8, read-only. This tests tolerance to rendering changes on controlled motifs, a first step toward isolated voices; it does not test another transposition ceiling, compositional understanding, natural Bach or polyphony.

Use forty fresh disjoint phrase groups: 8 development, 8 probability calibration, 24 evaluation. All paired histories, renderer variants and controls of a group stay in one split. Exclude prior phrase/seed identities; group variation must include genuinely different pitch/interval motifs, not merely new render seeds of a reused tune. Build short synthetic monophonic motifs from a three-note cue and one-note continuation, with a distractor cue sharing the final note but differing in ordered intervals. Use constrained step/leap contours in a comfortable fixed register; document the generator-defined fundamental-frequency target without claiming human pitch identity. Avoid systematic suffix collisions in development by a declared structural rule, not by rejecting evaluation outcomes. No external music corpus or soundfont download.

Keep the paired-history causal task: one history binds cue Q to continuation A and cue R to B; its counterpart swaps the successors. Histories in EACH acoustic condition must have identical multisets of actual sound-block bytes/counts, total duration, pitch inventory and energy. Cue/probe bytes, including the final two history events, are identical within each pair. Counterbalance demonstration order, successor recency and renderer/level associations. No condition labels, truth, candidate lists or generator metadata reach predictors.

Four predefined intact rendering cells:
1. Matched simple rendering and note duration.
2. Changed timbre/envelope between earlier demonstration and current cue, unchanged duration.
3. Changed note duration between demonstration and cue, unchanged timbre.
4. Both changes together, including parameter combinations not used in development/calibration.

Use only completed note blocks with supplied boundaries for this stage. Choose and freeze concrete renderer families/ranges on development: additive harmonic tones with nonzero fundamental, harmonic mixtures and attack/decay differences, normalized RMS, and durations within 0.08–0.40 seconds. Include a predefined overtone-rich subfamily so robustness is not guaranteed by making every tone nearly sinusoidal. Balance renderer direction and loudness across labels. Predeclare disjoint render parameter tuples/seeds and withheld combinations before evaluation; do not choose evaluation timbres after seeing performance. Apply acoustic transformations consistently to both members of a paired condition. Keep register fixed across cells; transposition is not the experimental factor. Missing/unreliable pitch remains an observation with uncertainty, never filled using truth.

In the joint-change cell include reset, relevant-successor removal with balanced same-duration masking, correctly retargeted history swap, information-preserving demonstration-chunk shuffle, and genuinely ambiguous histories with balanced futures. Freeze their semantics. Removal/reset must leave paired prefixes indistinguishable to the predictor; hold side channels and capacity constant. Chunk shuffle is not a test of arbitrary within-motif order destruction.

RESOURCES AND CAUSAL CONTRACT
At most 1,000 total episode/control streams including future substitutions across all splits; a concrete allocation is 40 groups × (8 intact streams + 10 control streams + 4 extra future-substitution forecast probes) = 880. Development revisions must remain within the total budget; keep a run ledger, reserve the full fixed evaluation allocation and stop if the cap would be exceeded. At most 32 arrived blocks including cue/probe before a forecast, with capacity sufficient and zero eviction; every completed block <=2 seconds. At most two hours aggregate local compute and 2 GiB of new retained artifacts. Existing installed local dependencies only. No paid compute, foundation training, MERT changes/downloads, simultaneous voices, natural performances, full fugue or second tuned evaluation.

Reuse the strict prefix-only arrival API/process isolation and append-only forecast-before-reveal logging. Extract only arrived blocks; no whole-future waveform features. Flush/fsync point forecast, normalized predictive distribution and model/prefix hashes before revealing the continuation or extracting it. Test unrevealed-future invariance in each intact cell/group. Keep raw acoustic observations, uncertainty, memory occupancy and lookup evidence. Require diagnostic records to remain outside the predictor process.

COMPARISONS AND BOUNDED DIAGNOSTIC
Primary reference: exact PR #8 selected retrieval code/config, unchanged. Run the same frozen reference on all four fresh cells; the matched cell is an internal control, not a rerun of PR #8.
Candidate: at most ONE newly parameterized instance of the same observation adapter/retrieval algorithm. Keep its acoustic observation/gating code and context structure fixed to the reference; development may select retrieval residual cutoff and calibration may fit only predictive temperature/width/smoothing. Predeclare a small finite grid on development. This isolates readout adaptation from extractor changes; do not tune the extractor in this assignment.
Compare present-only/marginal, last-match recency, development-selected transition orders 1–3, and strong sequence retrieval with absolute and relative matching. Give them the same arrived observations/history and meaningful full-context matching, ambiguity handling and search budget. Fit any new baseline parameters only on development/calibration. No new relational model is required; branch B is preserved.

Necessary diagnostic decision: if robustness fails, choose an observation repair versus a retrieval/readout repair, or leave localization unresolved. Predeclare one evaluator-only pitch-oracle comparison using the same temporal histories and models with the generator's arrived-note fundamentals substituted, never future truth. Produce it from saved episode records AFTER the real pre-reveal forecasts are committed, separately labeled non-acoustic diagnostic evidence. This is not a deployable predictor or a capability success. If both acoustic versions fail but the oracle passes, with >=0.10 accuracy gain and positive paired lower95 bound, observation repair is the candidate. If the oracle also fails, inspect only the saved exact-match/availability traces needed to determine whether an explicit retrieval/memory prerequisite failed; do not claim localization from failure alone. No standalone estimator audit, unrestricted ablations or post-hoc retuning.

FREEZE AND ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Before generating/exposing evaluation stimuli/results, freeze protocol, seeds/splits, stimulus cells and controls, code/config/model hashes, grids, budgets, target bins, .35-semitone point tolerance, probability definitions and metrics. Post the preregistration hash receipt on PR #2 before evaluation. Use the existing interval vocabulary with explicit unknown if adequate; if inadequate, settle a common fixed vocabulary during development for new models while reporting the frozen reference's true limitations transparently. Never reinterpret E08 logits as probabilities. Preserve zero-probability events as infinite log loss where applicable; do not silently clip to rescue a result.

Weight the 24 evaluation groups equally. Report accuracy, both-members paired success, log loss and Brier for all models and all cells, plus paired group-bootstrap 95% intervals (5,000 resamples, fixed seed declared before evaluation). Retain all outcomes. Use simultaneous/bootstrap familywise intervals for the three changed-cell versus matched accuracy contrasts when claiming robustness across all three; freeze the method, not post-hoc best-cell selection.

Validity gates precede every branch: paired byte/duration/inventory balance, identical present cue, split isolation, predictor isolation, pre-reveal commitment, future invariance, common budgets, no eviction, correct control targets and no evaluation tuning.
A model passes robustness only if: paired success >=0.80 in matched AND each changed cell; lower95 accuracy improvement over present-only >0 in the joint cell; each simultaneous lower95 bound for changed-minus-matched accuracy is >=-0.10; and joint-cell controls/uncertainty pass. Also require joint-cell mean log loss and Brier no worse than present-only.
Controls: reset/removal paired success <=0.10, accuracy <=0.55, paired distribution total variation <=1e-9; swaps equal counterpart distributions within1e-9 and paired success >=0.80; preserved-information shuffle accuracy drop <=0.10; ambiguity total mass on the two stipulated outcomes >=0.90, each probability within0.10 of0.5, max class probability <=0.60. Report every mechanism, do not require intentionally weak baselines to pass.
Apply A first when the unchanged reference passes. B requires candidate pass plus >=0.10 joint-cell accuracy improvement over frozen reference, positive lower95 paired bound and no worse joint proper scores. Otherwise C requires the specified localized prerequisite evidence; failing a threshold alone does not establish a cause. If no branch qualifies, select inconclusive. No enlarging groups, changing criteria, repaired retest or extra conditions after evaluation.

PUBLICATION AND REVIEW
Preserve all E08, previous audits and PR #8 artifacts/code/models/results byte-for-byte. Record actual execution revision separately from final publication SHA. Update only the living PROJECT_STATE.md plus the new isolated package. Include source and environment identifiers, recipe/wave hashes and acoustic caches, pre-reveal logs, protocol/split/model/calibration, group results for all conditions, diagnostic separation, concise report, branch action, checksums and checkpoint. Explain that supplied boundaries and stipulated motif continuation remain limitations.

Read local processed instruction IDs/versions/SHA and no-overlap lock before work. This comment supersedes only the old completed-experiment stop; do not mark it completed merely on reading. Reconcile any concurrent work; preserve/checkpoint rather than overwrite. Branch from the exact base above, verify live main and stop on conflicting scope; reuse a matching successor if one appears. Publish ONE complete draft PR targeting main, apply earworm-review-ready, then mark ready (or update matching ready PR with label present). Check sensitive files/conflicts, link exact head/output paths/PR on PR #2, save awaiting-review, release lock and stop. No worker merge, schedule change, extra signal-only commit, duplicate worker/reviewer or automatic follow-on run.

After review, the PM is authorized to issue the next justified bounded in-plan assignment under the decision filter. This worker invocation is authorized only for the experiment above.
